reading.title: A message to the class
reading.text: Hello, everyone! My name is Valeria Ríos, but please call me Vale. I'm a new student in this English class. Our teacher is Mr. Brown. He is very nice and he always speaks slowly. Today I'm happy and a little excited, but I'm also very tired. I don't understand every word in English, so I have a lot of questions. My classmate Daniel helps me with the answers. Thank you, Daniel! Nice to meet you all. See you tomorrow, and take care!

questions.q: What does Valeria want people to call her?
questions.explain_es: Ella dice please call me Vale, o sea que prefiere que le digan Vale, su nombre corto.

questions.q: Who is Mr. Brown?
questions.explain_es: El texto dice Our teacher is Mr. Brown. Daniel es el compañero de clase, no Mr. Brown.

questions.q: How does Valeria feel today?
questions.explain_es: Dice I'm happy and a little excited, but I'm also very tired: está contenta pero cansada.

questions.q: Why does Valeria have a lot of questions?
questions.explain_es: Tiene muchas preguntas porque no entiende todas las palabras en inglés: I don't understand every word.

questions.q: Who is Daniel?
questions.explain_es: Daniel es my classmate, es decir, un compañero de su clase que la ayuda.

script.en: Good morning! Excuse me, are you the new coworker?
Yes, I am. Hi! I'm Roberto Salinas.
Nice to meet you, Roberto. I'm Karen. How do you spell your last name?
S-A-L-I-N-A-S. And please, call me Rob.
Sure, Rob. How are you today?
Not bad, thanks. I'm a little tired, but I'm very excited.
Great! Our boss is Mr. Green. He's very kind.
Good to know. Thank you, Karen.
No problem. Welcome, and have a nice day!

questions.q: Where are Karen and Rob?
questions.explain_es: Karen pregunta si él es the new coworker, el compañero nuevo de trabajo, así que están en el trabajo.

questions.q: What is Rob's last name?
questions.explain_es: Su apellido es Salinas y lo deletrea S-A-L-I-N-A-S. Roberto es su nombre y Green es el jefe.

questions.q: How does Rob feel?
questions.explain_es: Él dice I'm a little tired, but I'm very excited: un poco cansado pero muy emocionado.

questions.q: Who is Mr. Green?
questions.explain_es: Karen dice Our boss is Mr. Green: es el jefe de los dos.

questions.q: What time of day is it?
questions.explain_es: Karen saluda con good morning, así que es en la mañana.

use.q: ___ name is Ana.
use.explain_es: Para decir mi nombre se usa el posesivo my: My name is Ana.

use.q: A: How are you? B: I'm ___, thanks.
use.explain_es: La respuesta normal a How are you? es I'm fine, thanks: estoy bien, gracias.

use.q: ___ me, can you repeat that, please?
use.explain_es: Para interrumpir o pedir algo con cortesía se dice Excuse me. La frase Sorry me no existe.

use.q: I'm ___ student at this school.
use.explain_es: Antes de una profesión o actividad se pone a: I'm a student. An se usa antes de sonido de vocal.

use.q: A: Thank you so much! B: You're ___.
use.explain_es: La respuesta a thank you es You're welcome: de nada.

use.q: It's lunch time and I ___ very hungry.
use.explain_es: Tener hambre se dice con to be: I am hungry. Nunca I have hungry.

use.q: You arrive at a party at 8 p.m. You say: Good ___, everyone!
use.explain_es: Al llegar en la noche se saluda con good evening. Good night es solo para despedirse o antes de dormir.

use.q: Sorry, I don't ___ the question. Can you say it again, please?
use.explain_es: I don't understand significa no entiendo. Por eso pides que repitan la pregunta.

use.q: What does the word tired ___?
use.explain_es: La pregunta correcta es What does ... mean? Después de does el verbo va sin -s.

use.q: Hi, ___! Nice to see you all today.
use.explain_es: Para saludar a un grupo completo se usa everyone: Hi, everyone!

writing.prompt_es: Escribe un mensaje corto a una compañera nueva de tu clase de inglés, Sofía. Salúdala, di tu nombre completo y cómo quieres que te diga, di cómo te sientes hoy y despídete.
writing.prompt_en: You have a new classmate called Sofía. Write a short message to her. Say hello, tell her your full name and what she can call you, say how you feel today and say goodbye.
writing.model_answer: Hi, Sofía! My name is Carlos Mijangos, but please call me Charlie. I'm a student in your English class. Today I'm happy but a little tired. Nice to meet you! See you tomorrow.
checklist_es: Un saludo (Hi o Hello)
Tu nombre completo y cómo te pueden llamar (call me...)
Cómo te sientes hoy con I'm + adjetivo
Una despedida (See you tomorrow, Bye, Take care)

read_aloud: Good morning, everyone. My name is Laura and I'm a new student.
Excuse me, can you spell that slowly, please?
questions: What's your name? How do you spell your last name?
How are you today?
How do you say hello to your boss? And to a good friend?

reading.title: Your new conversation partner
reading.text: Hi! I'm Tom Baker, your new conversation partner. I'm twenty-eight years old and I'm from Toronto, so I'm Canadian. I'm a teacher and I'm single. My birthday is in August. This is my friend Marta. She isn't Canadian. She's from Bogotá, so she's Colombian. She's thirty-one and she's married. We are in Guadalajara for work this year. My cell phone number is 333 418 2706 and my email is tombaker at fluentmail dot com. Write to me!

questions.q: Who is older?
questions.explain_es: Tom tiene 28 años y Marta 31, así que Marta es mayor.

questions.q: What nationality is Tom?
questions.explain_es: Tom es de Toronto, en Canadá, por eso dice I'm Canadian.

questions.q: Which sentence about Marta is true?
questions.explain_es: El texto dice she's married. El soltero es Tom, y Marta no es canadiense, es colombiana.

questions.q: When is Tom's birthday?
questions.explain_es: Tom dice My birthday is in August: su cumpleaños es en agosto.

questions.q: How can you contact Tom?
questions.explain_es: Tom da su número de celular y su correo, así que puedes contactarlo por teléfono o por email.

script.en: Good afternoon. Can I help you?
Yes, please. I want a member card for the gym.
Sure. What's your name, please?
Andrea Cruz. That's C-R-U-Z.
Thanks. And how old are you, Andrea?
I'm nineteen. My birthday is in January.
Okay. What's your address?
It's sixty Juárez Street, zip code four four six zero zero.
Sixteen Juárez Street?
No, sorry, sixty. Six, zero.

questions.q: Where is Andrea?
questions.explain_es: Andrea pide a member card for the gym, una credencial del gimnasio.

questions.q: How old is Andrea?
questions.explain_es: Ella dice I'm nineteen: tiene 19 años. Fíjate en el final -teen.

questions.q: How does Andrea spell her last name?
questions.explain_es: Ella deletrea su apellido: C-R-U-Z, con C al principio y Z al final.

questions.q: What is Andrea's address?
questions.explain_es: La recepcionista entiende sixteen, pero Andrea corrige: sixty, six zero. Es el número 60.

questions.q: When is Andrea's birthday?
questions.explain_es: Andrea dice My birthday is in January: en enero.

use.q: My parents ___ from Monterrey.
use.explain_es: Parents es plural (they), así que se usa are.

use.q: She ___ married. She's single.
use.explain_es: Si es soltera, no está casada: she isn't married. Con she se usa is o isn't.

use.q: I'm twenty-five ___ old.
use.explain_es: La edad se dice I'm 25 years old, con years en plural.

use.q: Where ___ you from?
use.explain_es: Con you se usa are: Where are you from?

use.q: My birthday is ___ April.
use.explain_es: Con los meses se usa in: in April.

use.q: Luiz is from Brazil. He's ___.
use.explain_es: Brazil es el país y Brazilian es la nacionalidad. Después de He's va la nacionalidad.

use.q: Fifteen plus fifteen is ___.
use.explain_es: 15 + 15 = 30, que se dice thirty. No lo confundas con thirteen, que es 13.

use.q: They ___ Canadian. They're American.
use.explain_es: Si son estadounidenses, no son canadienses: they aren't Canadian. Con they se usa are o aren't.

use.q: A: What's your ___? B: It's analopez@mail.com.
use.explain_es: La respuesta tiene arroba, así que es un correo electrónico: email.

use.q: I ___ twenty years old.
use.explain_es: En inglés la edad va con to be: I am twenty. Nunca I have twenty years.

writing.prompt_es: Vas a tener un compañero de conversación de otro país. Escríbele un mensaje con tu nombre, tu edad, de dónde eres, el mes de tu cumpleaños y tu email.
writing.prompt_en: You have a new conversation partner from another country. Write a message to your partner. Tell him or her your name, your age, where you are from, the month of your birthday and your email address.
writing.model_answer: Hi! I'm Diego Ramírez. I'm twenty-two years old and I'm from Oaxaca, Mexico. My birthday is in December. I'm a student and I'm single. My email is diego22 at mail dot com.
checklist_es: Tu nombre (I'm... o My name is...)
Tu edad con I'm ... years old
De dónde eres con I'm from...
El mes de tu cumpleaños con in
Tu correo electrónico

read_aloud: My phone number is five five, three nine zero, one four seven two.
She's fifteen, not fifty. Her birthday is in August.
questions: Where are you from?
How old are you, and when is your birthday?
What's your phone number? Say it slowly, please.

reading.title: My family photo
reading.text: Hi, I'm Sara, and this is a photo of my family. My dad is the tall man with a beard. He's very funny. My mom has long curly hair and brown eyes. She's a teacher and she's very kind. My brother Pablo is twenty. He's smart, but a little lazy! My sister Inés and I are twins. We look the same, but we are very different. She's friendly and I'm shy. My grandparents live with us. My grandmother is short and thin, and my grandfather has a big mustache.

questions.q: Who has a beard?
questions.explain_es: Sara dice My dad is the tall man with a beard. El abuelo tiene bigote (mustache), no barba.

questions.q: Which word describes Sara's mom?
questions.explain_es: Sara dice que su mamá is very kind. Lazy describe a Pablo y shy describe a Sara.

questions.q: Who is the same age as Sara?
questions.explain_es: Sara e Inés son twins, gemelas, así que tienen la misma edad.

questions.q: How are Sara and Inés different?
options: Inés is friendly and Sara is shy.
Inés has curly hair and Sara has glasses.
Inés is tall and Sara is short.
questions.explain_es: Se ven iguales, pero su personalidad es distinta: Inés es amigable y Sara es tímida.

questions.q: Who lives in Sara's house?
options: Only her parents and her brother
Her parents, her brother and sister, and her grandparents
questions.explain_es: Además de sus papás y hermanos, dice My grandparents live with us: los abuelos viven con ellos.

script.en: Who's this woman in the photo?
That's my aunt Rosa. She's my mom's sister.
She's pretty! Is the boy her son?
Yes, that's Leo, my cousin. He's ten.
And the man with glasses? Is he your uncle?
No, my uncle is the tall man with the beard. The man with glasses is my grandfather.
Really? He looks young!
I know. He's seventy-two, but he's very strong and funny.
And who are the two girls?
They're my uncle's daughters, Mia and Ana. They're twins, but Mia has short hair and Ana has long hair.

questions.q: Who is Rosa?
questions.explain_es: B dice She's my mom's sister: Rosa es la hermana de su mamá, o sea su tía.

questions.q: How old is Leo?
questions.explain_es: B dice He's ten. Setenta y dos es la edad del abuelo.

questions.q: Who is the man with glasses?
questions.explain_es: B corrige: el tío es el de barba y the man with glasses is my grandfather.

questions.q: What does B's uncle look like?
options: He's tall and he has a beard.
questions.explain_es: B dice my uncle is the tall man with the beard: alto y con barba.

questions.q: What is true about Mia and Ana?
options: They are twins with different hair.
questions.explain_es: Son gemelas e hijas del tío (primas de B), pero Mia tiene el pelo corto y Ana largo.

use.q: Carla is my mom's sister. She's my ___.
use.explain_es: La hermana de tu mamá es tu tía: aunt. Uncle es tío.

use.q: This is Tom and ___ wife, Ellen.
use.explain_es: La esposa es de Tom, un hombre, así que se usa his.

use.q: My sister ___ long hair.
use.explain_es: Con she (my sister) se usa has: she has long hair.

use.q: Those are my cousins. ___ house is very big.
use.explain_es: La casa es de ellos (my cousins), así que se usa their. They es un pronombre, no posesivo.

use.q: We have a ___.
use.explain_es: El adjetivo va antes del sustantivo y no cambia: a big family. Con a se usa singular.

use.q: My father's father is my ___.
use.explain_es: El papá de tu papá es tu abuelo: grandfather.

use.q: They have two ___, a boy and a girl.
use.explain_es: El plural de child es irregular: children. Childs y childrens no existen.

use.q: This is my ___ car. He loves it.
use.explain_es: Para decir de quién es algo se usa 's: my brother's car, el coche de mi hermano.

use.q: He doesn't talk a lot with new people. He's very ___.
use.explain_es: Una persona que casi no habla con gente nueva es tímida: shy.

use.q: My sister and I are twins. We look the ___.
use.explain_es: Look the same significa vernos iguales, algo normal en gemelos.

writing.prompt_es: Escribe sobre una persona de tu familia. Di quién es, cuántos años tiene, cómo es físicamente y cómo es su personalidad.
writing.prompt_en: Write about a person in your family. Say who the person is, how old he or she is, what he or she looks like, and what he or she is like.
writing.model_answer: My brother's name is Luis. He's twenty-five years old. He's tall and thin, and he has short curly hair and brown eyes. He's very funny and kind. I love him!
checklist_es: Quién es la persona (my brother, my aunt...)
Su edad
Cómo es físicamente con is o has (tall, long hair, glasses)
Su personalidad con un adjetivo (funny, kind, shy)
Usar bien his o her

read_aloud: My grandmother has short curly hair and glasses.
Their children are very friendly, but their son is a little shy.
questions: Tell me about your family. How many people are in your family?
Describe your best friend. What does he or she look like?
Who do you look like in your family?

reading.title: Apartment for rent
reading.text: FOR RENT: Nice two-bedroom apartment on the third floor of a quiet building in the Roma neighborhood. There is an elevator, so no stairs! The living room is big and sunny, with a new couch and a TV. The kitchen has a fridge, a stove and a microwave. There are two bathrooms, and one has a bathtub. The apartment is furnished. There isn't a garage, but there is parking on the street. Rent is 9,000 pesos a month. No pets, sorry. Call Mrs. Ortega.

questions.q: Why is the elevator good?
options: The apartment is on the first floor.
You don't need to use the stairs.
questions.explain_es: El anuncio dice There is an elevator, so no stairs: con el elevador no tienes que subir escaleras al tercer piso.

questions.q: What is in the living room?
questions.explain_es: La sala tiene a new couch and a TV. El refri y la estufa están en la cocina.

questions.q: Which sentence about the apartment is true?
questions.explain_es: Furnished significa amueblado, o sea que tiene muebles. Tiene dos baños y sí tiene estufa.

questions.q: Where can you park your car?
questions.explain_es: Dice There isn't a garage, but there is parking on the street: puedes estacionarte en la calle.

questions.q: Who can't rent this apartment?
questions.explain_es: El anuncio dice No pets: no se permiten mascotas, así que una persona con perro no puede rentarlo.

script.en: Mom, where are my keys?
Are they on the table in the kitchen?
No, they aren't. There's a cup and a plate, but no keys.
Look in your bedroom. Maybe they're on your desk, next to the lamp.
No, they aren't there. And my bedroom is so messy!
Okay. Look in the living room, under the couch.
Under the couch? Wait... yes! Here they are, between a pillow and a book.
Good. Now please clean your bedroom before dinner.

questions.q: What is A looking for?
questions.explain_es: Desde el principio A pregunta where are my keys?: busca sus llaves.

questions.q: What is on the kitchen table?
questions.explain_es: A dice There's a cup and a plate, but no keys: en la mesa solo hay una taza y un plato.

questions.q: What is A's bedroom like?
questions.explain_es: A dice my bedroom is so messy: su cuarto está muy desordenado.

questions.q: Where are the keys?
questions.explain_es: Las llaves aparecen debajo del sillón de la sala, entre una almohada y un libro.

questions.q: What does Mom want A to do?
questions.explain_es: La mamá dice please clean your bedroom before dinner: que limpie su cuarto.

use.q: ___ a big yard behind the house.
use.explain_es: Yard es singular (a big yard) y la oración es afirmativa: There is.

use.q: ___ two bathrooms in the apartment.
use.explain_es: Con dos o más cosas se usa there are.

use.q: How many bedrooms ___ there?
use.explain_es: La pregunta es How many + plural + are there?

use.q: I can't see the cat because it's ___ the bed.
use.explain_es: Si no ves al gato es porque está debajo de la cama: under.

use.q: The kitchen is ___ the living room and the bathroom.
use.explain_es: Between significa entre dos cosas. Next y in front necesitan to y of.

use.q: You wash the dishes in the ___.
use.explain_es: Los trastes se lavan en el fregadero: sink. Shower es la regadera.

use.q: My room is ___. There are clothes on the floor.
use.explain_es: Si hay ropa en el piso, el cuarto está desordenado: messy.

use.q: The milk is cold. It's in the ___.
use.explain_es: La leche fría está en el refri: fridge. La estufa y el horno están calientes.

use.q: My bedroom is on the second floor. It's ___.
use.explain_es: Si tu cuarto está en el segundo piso, está arriba: upstairs, sin in ni on.

use.q: The apartment is ___. It has a bed, a table and a couch.
use.explain_es: Furnished significa amueblado: ya tiene muebles como cama, mesa y sillón.

writing.prompt_es: Tu amigo quiere saber cómo es tu casa o departamento. Escríbele un mensaje: di qué cuartos hay, cuál es tu cuarto favorito y qué cosas hay en él.
writing.prompt_en: Your friend wants to know about your home. Write a message to your friend. Say what rooms there are, which room is your favorite, and what is in that room.
writing.model_answer: I live in a small apartment. There are two bedrooms, a kitchen and a living room. My favorite room is my bedroom. There is a big bed and a desk next to the window.
checklist_es: Si es casa o departamento y cómo es (small, new, quiet)
Los cuartos con there is o there are
Tu cuarto favorito
Al menos dos cosas que hay en ese cuarto y dónde están (next to, on, in)

read_aloud: There are three bedrooms upstairs and a big kitchen downstairs.
The lamp is on the desk, next to the window.
questions: Describe your bedroom. What is in it?
What is your favorite room in your home? Why?
Is your neighborhood quiet or noisy?

reading.title: Welcome to Café Lupita
reading.text: Welcome to Café Lupita! Our breakfast is famous: eggs with beans, fresh bread and orange juice. For lunch, try our chicken soup. It's delicious, but a little spicy. Are you vegetarian? Ask for the soup without chicken, or try our cheese and avocado sandwich. Our cakes and cookies are very sweet. Coffee refills are free. You can eat here or order to go. Please tell the waiter if you are allergic to any food. Sorry, we don't take reservations on Sundays.

questions.q: What is in the famous breakfast?
questions.explain_es: El desayuno famoso tiene huevos con frijoles, pan fresco y jugo de naranja.

questions.q: What can a vegetarian person eat?
questions.explain_es: Un vegetariano no come carne. El café le recomienda el sándwich de queso y aguacate o la sopa sin pollo.

questions.q: What is free?
questions.explain_es: Coffee refills are free: si pides otra taza de café (refill), no la pagas.

questions.q: When do you need to talk to the waiter?
options: When you are allergic to some food
When you want a refill of soda
When you want the menu in Spanish
questions.explain_es: El texto pide decirle al mesero si eres alérgico a alguna comida.

questions.q: What can't you do on Sundays?
questions.explain_es: Dice we don't take reservations on Sundays: los domingos no aceptan reservaciones.

script.en: Good evening. Are you ready to order?
Yes. I'd like the chicken tacos, please. Are they spicy?
Not very. And the hot sauce is on the table.
Perfect. Can I have a salad without onion? I'm allergic to onion.
No problem. Would you like something to drink?
An orange juice, please. Oh, no, sorry. A lemonade.
Sure. And would you like dessert? The ice cream is delicious.
No, thanks. But I'd like a coffee after dinner.
Of course. With milk and sugar?
Just milk, please. No sugar.

questions.q: What does B order to eat?
questions.explain_es: B pide the chicken tacos y también a salad without onion.

questions.q: Why doesn't B want onion?
questions.explain_es: B dice I'm allergic to onion: es alérgico a la cebolla.

questions.q: What does B drink with dinner?
questions.explain_es: Primero pide jugo de naranja, pero cambia de idea: Oh, no, sorry. A lemonade.

questions.q: What dessert does B order?
questions.explain_es: El mesero ofrece helado, pero B dice No, thanks. Solo pide un café.

questions.q: How does B want the coffee?
questions.explain_es: B dice Just milk, please. No sugar: solo con leche.

use.q: Is there ___ milk in the fridge?
use.explain_es: En preguntas con is there se usa any: Is there any milk?

use.q: I'm thirsty. I'd like ___ water, please.
use.explain_es: Al pedir algo en afirmativo se usa some: I'd like some water.

use.q: A: ___ like some coffee? B: Yes, please.
use.explain_es: Para ofrecer algo con amabilidad se dice Would you like...? Do you like pregunta si algo te gusta en general.

use.q: ___ have the check, please?
use.explain_es: Para pedir algo se dice Can I have...? El orden es Can + I en la pregunta.

use.q: Lemons are very ___.
use.explain_es: El limón es ácido: sour.

use.q: I'm ___. I don't eat meat or fish.
use.explain_es: Una persona que no come carne ni pescado es vegetarian.

use.q: You eat soup with a ___.
use.explain_es: La sopa se come con cuchara: spoon.

use.q: Every morning I have eggs and bread for ___.
use.explain_es: La comida de la mañana es el desayuno: breakfast.

use.q: A: For here or ___ go? B: For here, please.
use.explain_es: Para llevar se dice to go: For here or to go?

use.q: This soup ___ very good!
use.explain_es: Con taste se usa un adjetivo: It tastes good. Con it o this soup el verbo lleva -s.

writing.prompt_es: Escribe un mensaje a un amigo sobre tu restaurante favorito. Di cómo se llama, qué comida te gusta ahí, qué te gusta tomar y por qué te gusta el lugar.
writing.prompt_en: Write a message to a friend about your favorite restaurant. Say its name, what food you like there, what you like to drink and why you like it.
writing.model_answer: My favorite restaurant is El Fogón. The tacos are delicious and a little spicy. I like the horchata too. The food is cheap and the waiters are very friendly. Let's go there!
checklist_es: El nombre del restaurante
Una comida y cómo sabe (delicious, spicy, sweet)
Una bebida
Una razón por la que te gusta (cheap, friendly waiters, fresh food)

read_aloud: I'd like the chicken soup and an orange juice, please.
Can I have the check? And a box to go, please.
questions: What do you have for breakfast?
What is your favorite food? Is it sweet, salty or spicy?
You are in a restaurant. Order your favorite meal and a drink.

reading.title: Marco's night job
reading.text: Marco works at night in a hospital in Monterrey. He gets up at six p.m., takes a shower and has breakfast at seven. He starts work at nine p.m. and finishes at seven a.m. Then he gets home, has dinner and goes to bed at nine in the morning. Marco works from Monday to Thursday. On Fridays, he always does the laundry and cleans the apartment. On weekends, he sleeps in, visits his parents and sometimes plays soccer. He never cooks on workdays.

questions.q: When does Marco have breakfast?
questions.explain_es: Marco se levanta a las seis de la tarde y desayuna a las siete, o sea, en la noche.

questions.q: How many hours does Marco work every night?
questions.explain_es: Empieza a las 9 p.m. y termina a las 7 a.m.: son diez horas.

questions.q: What does Marco do every Friday?
questions.explain_es: Los viernes siempre lava la ropa y limpia el departamento: hace tareas de la casa (chores).

questions.q: What does Marco do on weekends?
options: He gets up at six a.m.
questions.explain_es: Los fines de semana duerme tarde, visita a sus papás y a veces juega futbol.

questions.q: Which sentence is true?
questions.explain_es: Marco se duerme a las nueve de la mañana, así que duerme de día. Nunca cocina los días de trabajo y no trabaja los sábados.

script.en: Hey, Luis! Do you want to go out on Saturday?
Saturday? Sorry, I work on Saturdays.
Oh. What time do you finish?
At half past two. Then I go home and take a nap.
Okay. How about Sunday? We can play soccer in the morning.
Hmm, I usually sleep in on Sundays. I get up at eleven.
No problem. Let's meet at a quarter past twelve, then.
Perfect. But I do the laundry on Sunday afternoon, so I go home at four.
That's fine. See you on Sunday!

questions.q: Why can't Luis go out on Saturday?
questions.explain_es: Luis dice I work on Saturdays: trabaja los sábados.

questions.q: What time does Luis finish work on Saturday?
questions.explain_es: Half past two significa dos y media: 2:30.

questions.q: What does Luis usually do on Sunday mornings?
questions.explain_es: Luis dice I usually sleep in on Sundays: duerme hasta tarde, se levanta a las once.

questions.q: What time do they meet?
questions.explain_es: A quarter past twelve es doce y cuarto: 12:15.

questions.q: Why does Luis go home at four?
questions.explain_es: Luis lava la ropa el domingo en la tarde (do the laundry), que es una tarea de la casa.

use.q: She ___ up at six every day.
use.explain_es: En presente simple con she el verbo lleva -s: she gets up.

use.q: I ___ breakfast on weekdays. I'm always late!
use.explain_es: El adverbio de frecuencia va antes del verbo: I never have. En inglés no se usa doble negación.

use.q: My class starts ___ eight o'clock.
use.explain_es: Con las horas se usa at: at eight o'clock.

use.q: We go to the market ___ Saturdays.
use.explain_es: Con los días de la semana se usa on: on Saturdays.

use.q: It's 3:30. It's half ___ three.
use.explain_es: Las tres y media se dice half past three.

use.q: A: ___ does your brother finish work? B: At five.
use.explain_es: La respuesta es una hora (at five), así que la pregunta es What time.

use.q: My dad ___ TV in the evening.
use.explain_es: Con he o she, los verbos que terminan en ch agregan -es: watches.

use.q: I clean the house ___ a week, on Sundays.
use.explain_es: Una vez a la semana se dice once a week.

use.q: After dinner, I ___ the dishes.
use.explain_es: Lavar los trastes se dice wash the dishes (o do the dishes). Make the dishes no existe.

use.q: My brother doesn't ___ on Sundays. He sleeps in.
use.explain_es: Después de doesn't el verbo va en forma base, sin -s: he doesn't work.

writing.prompt_es: Escribe sobre un sábado normal para ti. Di a qué hora te levantas y qué haces en la mañana, en la tarde y en la noche. Usa por lo menos una palabra de frecuencia (always, usually, sometimes, never).
writing.prompt_en: Write about a typical Saturday for you. Say what time you get up and what you do in the morning, in the afternoon and in the evening. Use at least one word like always, usually, sometimes or never.
writing.model_answer: On Saturdays I get up at nine. In the morning I always clean the house and do the laundry. In the afternoon I sometimes visit my grandparents. At night I go out with friends.
checklist_es: La hora a la que te levantas con at
Qué haces en la mañana, en la tarde y en la noche
Al menos un adverbio de frecuencia antes del verbo
Verbos en presente simple (I get up, I clean...)

read_aloud: I usually get up at half past six and take a shower.
She never goes to bed before midnight on weekends.
questions: What time do you get up on weekdays?
What do you do in your free time?
Which chores do you do at home, and how often?

reading.title: Which dress?
reading.text: Hi Jess! I'm at Moda Store and there's a big sale this week. Everything is thirty percent off! I'm looking for a dress for Ana's party on Saturday. There's a long blue dress for sixty dollars and a short red one for forty-five. The red one is cheaper, but the blue one is cotton and it's more comfortable. I prefer the blue one, but it's a size medium and I usually wear small. I think a medium is too loose for me. The cashier says exchanges are okay if it doesn't fit, but there are no refunds on sale items. What do you think? Which one is better? Call me, I'm here until seven! Love, Mariana

questions.q: Why is Mariana shopping?
options: She needs a dress for a party.
She wants a gift for Jess.
She wants to return a dress.
questions.explain_es: Mariana dice I'm looking for a dress for Ana's party: busca un vestido para una fiesta.

questions.q: What is true about the blue dress?
options: It costs more, but it's more comfortable.
It's short and made of cotton.
It's cheaper than the red one.
questions.explain_es: El azul cuesta 60 dólares y el rojo 45, pero el azul es de algodón y más cómodo. Además el azul es largo.

questions.q: What is the problem with the blue dress?
questions.explain_es: El vestido es talla mediana y ella normalmente usa chica, por eso piensa que le queda flojo, no apretado.

questions.q: If the dress doesn't fit, what can Mariana do?
options: Change it for a different one
questions.explain_es: Puede hacer un exchange (cambiarlo por otro), pero no hay refund (devolución de dinero) en artículos de oferta.

questions.q: What does Mariana want Jess to do?
questions.explain_es: Mariana pregunta What do you think? Which one is better?: quiere la opinión de Jess.

script.en: Hi, can I help you?
Yes, I'm looking for sneakers. How much are these white ones?
Those are eighty-five dollars. But these gray ones are on sale. They're only fifty-five.
Oh, they're much cheaper. Can I try them on? I'm a size eight.
Sure, here you go. How do they fit?
Hmm, they're a little tight. Do you have them in an eight and a half?
Let me check. Yes, here you are.
These are perfect. I'll take them. Can I pay by credit card?
Of course. Here's your receipt. You have thirty days to exchange them.

questions.q: Which sneakers does B try on?
questions.explain_es: B prueba los grises porque están en oferta y son más baratos que los blancos.

questions.q: How much are the gray sneakers?
questions.explain_es: La vendedora dice these gray ones are on sale. They're only fifty-five.

questions.q: What is wrong with the first pair B tries on?
questions.explain_es: B dice they're a little tight: le quedan apretados.

questions.q: What size does B buy?
questions.explain_es: La talla ocho le aprieta, así que pide y compra la ocho y media.

questions.q: What can B do in the next thirty days?
questions.explain_es: La vendedora dice You have thirty days to exchange them: puede cambiarlos durante 30 días.

use.q: These shoes are ___ than those boots.
use.explain_es: Cheap es un adjetivo corto, así que el comparativo es cheaper than.

use.q: This jacket is ___ expensive than that one.
use.explain_es: Expensive es un adjetivo largo, así que el comparativo es more expensive than.

use.q: How much ___ these jeans?
use.explain_es: Jeans siempre es plural, así que se dice How much are these jeans?

use.q: I really like ___ sunglasses over there.
use.explain_es: Para cosas en plural que están lejos (over there) se usa those.

use.q: These pants are too ___. I need a bigger size.
use.explain_es: Si necesitas una talla más grande es porque el pantalón te aprieta: tight.

use.q: A: Can I help you? B: No, thanks. I'm just ___.
use.explain_es: Cuando no necesitas ayuda en una tienda se dice I'm just looking: solo estoy viendo.

use.q: I want to return this sweater. Here's my ___.
use.explain_es: Para devolver algo te piden el comprobante de compra: receipt.

use.q: Your sweater is nice, but I think mine is ___.
use.explain_es: El comparativo de good es irregular: better. Gooder y more good no existen.

use.q: Which one do you ___, the striped shirt or the plain one?
use.explain_es: Después de do you el verbo va en forma base: Which one do you prefer?

use.q: I can't wear these jeans. I want to ___ them for a bigger size.
use.explain_es: Cambiar algo por otra cosa (otra talla) es exchange. Refund es que te regresen el dinero.

writing.prompt_es: Escríbele un email a un amigo sobre algo que quieres comprar. Di qué es, de qué color y talla, cuánto cuesta y por qué lo prefieres en lugar de otra opción. Invita a tu amigo a ir de compras contigo.
writing.prompt_en: Write an email to a friend about something you want to buy. Say what it is, its color and size, how much it costs, and why you prefer it to another one. Invite your friend to go shopping with you.
writing.model_answer: Hi Rita! There's a big sale at the mall this week. I want to buy a black jacket in size medium for forty dollars. The gray one is more expensive and a little tight. The black one is more comfortable. Do you want to come with me on Saturday?
checklist_es: Qué quieres comprar, con color y talla
El precio
Una comparación con otra opción (cheaper, more comfortable, better than)
Una invitación a tu amigo (Do you want to come...?)

read_aloud: Excuse me, how much are these striped sweaters?
The cotton shirt is cheaper and more comfortable than the other one.
questions: What clothes do you usually wear on weekends?
Do you prefer shopping online or at the mall? Why?
Think of two stores in your city. Which one is better, and why?

reading.title: How to get to my place
reading.text: Hi Alex! Welcome to Guadalajara! Here's how to get to my apartment from the airport. Don't take a taxi at the door, because they're very expensive. Take the airport bus to the central station. It usually takes about forty minutes, but it can take more at rush hour. At the station, get off and take the subway to Plaza Patria. That's four stops. When you come out of the station, turn left and walk straight ahead for two blocks. My building is across from a big pharmacy, between a bank and a small park. I'm working right now, so my neighbor Mrs. Paz is waiting for you with the keys. She lives on the first floor. Send me a message when you arrive! Diego

questions.q: Why does Diego say not to take a taxi?
options: There aren't any at the airport.
questions.explain_es: Diego dice they're very expensive: los taxis del aeropuerto son muy caros.

questions.q: How long is the bus trip when there isn't much traffic?
questions.explain_es: El camión hace unos cuarenta minutos. A la hora pico (rush hour) puede tardar más. Cuatro paradas es el metro.

questions.q: Which types of transport does Alex need?
questions.explain_es: Alex toma el camión del aeropuerto y luego el metro hasta Plaza Patria. No toma taxi.

questions.q: Where is Diego's building?
options: On the other side of the street from a pharmacy
questions.explain_es: Across from significa enfrente, cruzando la calle. El edificio está entre un banco y un parque.

questions.q: Why isn't Diego at home?
questions.explain_es: Diego dice I'm working right now: está trabajando, por eso su vecina tiene las llaves.

script.en: Hi, Sam? Where are you? The movie starts in twenty minutes!
I know, I'm so sorry! I'm on the bus right now, but there's a lot of traffic.
Oh no. Where are you exactly?
We're crossing the bridge near the museum. The bus is moving really slowly.
Okay, get off at the next stop and take the subway. It's faster.
Good idea. Which station?
Get on at Hidalgo and get off at Centro. The theater is around the corner from the station, next to the post office.
How long does it take on the subway?
About ten minutes. Hurry up!

questions.q: Why is Sam late?
options: There is a lot of traffic.
questions.explain_es: Sam dice I'm on the bus right now, but there's a lot of traffic: va en el camión pero hay mucho tráfico.

questions.q: Where is Sam right now?
options: On a bridge, on the bus
questions.explain_es: Sam dice We're crossing the bridge near the museum: el camión está cruzando un puente.

questions.q: What does A tell Sam to do?
options: Get off the bus and take the subway
questions.explain_es: A le dice get off at the next stop and take the subway porque el metro es más rápido.

questions.q: Where is the movie theater?
questions.explain_es: El cine está a la vuelta de la estación Centro, junto a la oficina de correos.

questions.q: How long is the trip on the subway?
questions.explain_es: A dice About ten minutes. Veinte minutos es lo que falta para que empiece la película.

use.q: Go straight and ___ left at the traffic light.
use.explain_es: Las indicaciones usan el imperativo: el verbo en forma base sin sujeto, turn left.

use.q: Shh! Dad ___ on the phone right now.
use.explain_es: Para algo que pasa en este momento (right now) se usa el presente continuo: is talking.

use.q: I usually go to school ___ bus.
use.explain_es: Con medios de transporte se usa by sin artículo: by bus, by car.

use.q: I live near my office, so I go to work ___ foot.
use.explain_es: A pie se dice on foot, no by foot.

use.q: A: ___ is it from here to the airport? B: About twenty kilometers.
use.explain_es: La respuesta es una distancia en kilómetros, así que se pregunta How far.

use.q: ___ cross the street here. It's dangerous.
use.explain_es: El imperativo negativo se forma con Don't + verbo: Don't cross.

use.q: The pharmacy is ___ the street from the bank. Just cross and you're there.
use.explain_es: Across the street from significa enfrente, del otro lado de la calle.

use.q: Our flight is ___. It's leaving two hours late.
use.explain_es: Si el vuelo sale tarde, está retrasado: delayed.

use.q: It ___ thirty minutes to get downtown by subway.
use.explain_es: Para decir cuánto tiempo se hace a un lugar se usa It takes + tiempo.

use.q: Be ___! There's a lot of traffic on this highway.
use.explain_es: Después de be va un adjetivo: Be careful, ten cuidado.

writing.prompt_es: Una amiga va a visitarte por primera vez. Escríbele un mensaje para explicarle cómo llegar a tu casa desde una estación de metro o de camión. Di qué transporte tomar, cuánto tiempo se hace y cómo llegar caminando. Menciona un lugar que está cerca de tu casa.
writing.prompt_en: A friend is visiting you for the first time. Write a message to explain how to get to your home from a subway or bus station. Say what transport to take, how long it takes and how to walk there. Mention a place near your home.
writing.model_answer: Hi Paola! Take the subway to Insurgentes station. It takes about twenty minutes. When you get off, turn right and walk straight ahead for two blocks. My building is across from a big supermarket, next to a bank. See you soon!
checklist_es: Qué transporte tomar (take the subway, take the bus)
Cuánto tiempo se hace con It takes...
Indicaciones con imperativos (turn right, walk straight ahead, cross)
Un lugar cercano con preposición (across from, next to, between)

read_aloud: Go straight ahead for two blocks and turn left at the traffic light.
Our flight is delayed, so we're waiting at the gate right now.
questions: How do you get to work or school? How long does it take?
Give directions from your home to a supermarket near you.
What are the people in your home doing right now?

reading.title: A weekend in Puerto Escondido
reading.text: Last month, my sister and I traveled to Puerto Escondido for a long weekend. We took a night bus from Oaxaca City. The trip was ten hours long and I didn't sleep at all! We stayed in a small hotel near the beach. On Saturday morning we swam in the ocean, and then we ate fish tacos at a little restaurant. They were delicious. After that, my sister bought souvenirs for our parents. On Sunday I lost my phone on the beach and I was very sad. But that evening, a young surfer came to our hotel with it. He found it in the sand! We invited him to dinner to say thank you. Finally, on Monday, we flew home. It was much faster!

questions.q: How did they travel to Puerto Escondido?
questions.explain_es: Dice We took a night bus from Oaxaca City. En avión (flew) fue solo el regreso.

questions.q: Why was the bus trip hard for the writer?
questions.explain_es: El viaje duró diez horas y I didn't sleep at all: no durmió nada.

questions.q: Who were the souvenirs for?
questions.explain_es: La hermana compró recuerdos for our parents, para sus papás.

questions.q: What happened on Sunday?
options: The writer lost a phone, and a surfer returned it.
The writer bought a new phone.
The writer met their parents at the beach.
questions.explain_es: El domingo perdió su celular en la playa y en la tarde un surfista lo llevó al hotel.

questions.q: Why did they have dinner with the surfer?
options: Because he was an old friend
Because he worked at the hotel
To thank him for his help
questions.explain_es: Lo invitaron a cenar to say thank you, para darle las gracias por regresar el celular.

script.en: Hi, Pete! How was your weekend?
It was great, thanks. I went to my cousin's wedding in Querétaro.
Oh, nice! Did you drive there?
No, I didn't. My car is at the mechanic's, so I took the bus on Friday night.
And how was the wedding?
So much fun! I danced a lot and I met some really nice people. But I ate too much cake!
Ha! What did you do on Sunday?
I slept until noon, and then I came home. What about you?
Oh, it was boring. I stayed home and studied for my English exam.

questions.q: Why did Pete go to Querétaro?
options: For a vacation at the beach
questions.explain_es: Pete fue a la boda de su primo: my cousin's wedding.

questions.q: How did Pete travel?
questions.explain_es: Pete dice I took the bus on Friday night.

questions.q: Why didn't Pete drive?
questions.explain_es: Su coche está en el taller (at the mechanic's), o sea que tenía un problema.

questions.q: What did Pete do on Sunday morning?
questions.explain_es: Pete dice I slept until noon: durmió hasta el mediodía.

questions.q: How was A's weekend?
questions.explain_es: A dice it was boring: se quedó en casa estudiando para su examen.

use.q: I ___ at home all day yesterday.
use.explain_es: El pasado de to be con I es was.

use.q: We ___ a great movie last night.
use.explain_es: Last night indica pasado. Watch es regular, así que se agrega -ed: watched.

use.q: They ___ to Cancún last summer.
use.explain_es: Go es irregular: su pasado es went. Goed no existe.

use.q: ___ you see the game on Sunday?
use.explain_es: Las preguntas en pasado con verbos normales usan Did + verbo en forma base.

use.q: I didn't ___ breakfast this morning.
use.explain_es: Después de didn't el verbo regresa a su forma base: I didn't eat.

use.q: My parents ___ married in 1995.
use.explain_es: Casarse en pasado es got married. Get es irregular y su pasado es got.

use.q: I met my best friend ten years ___.
use.explain_es: Hace diez años se dice ten years ago, con ago al final.

use.q: He ___ a lot for the exam last week.
use.explain_es: Study termina en consonante + y, así que en pasado cambia a -ied: studied.

use.q: A: ___ was your vacation? B: It was amazing!
use.explain_es: La respuesta describe cómo estuvo (amazing), así que se pregunta How was...?

use.q: First we had dinner. ___ that, we went dancing.
use.explain_es: La expresión es After that: después de eso. Then that y Finally that no son correctas.

writing.prompt_es: Escríbele un email a un amigo sobre tu fin de semana pasado. Di a dónde fuiste o con quién estuviste, dos cosas que hiciste y cómo estuvo. Termina con una pregunta para tu amigo.
writing.prompt_en: Write an email to a friend about last weekend. Say where you went or who you were with, two things you did and how it was. End with a question for your friend.
writing.model_answer: Hi Andrés! Last weekend I went to Puebla with my family. On Saturday we visited some old churches and ate mole. On Sunday we bought souvenirs for my grandparents. It was a great trip, but I was very tired! How was your weekend?
checklist_es: A dónde fuiste o con quién (I went to..., I was with...)
Dos actividades en pasado simple (regulares e irregulares)
Cómo estuvo con was (It was great, fun, boring)
Una pregunta final como How was your weekend?

read_aloud: Last summer we traveled to the beach and stayed in a small hotel.
I didn't go out on Saturday. I watched a movie and slept early.
questions: What did you do last weekend?
Tell me about your last vacation. Where did you go and what did you do?
What did you eat yesterday?

reading.title: Job opening: part-time salesperson
reading.text: Sol Shoes is hiring! We are a family store in downtown Mérida and we need a friendly part-time salesperson for weekends and Wednesday afternoons. You don't have to have experience, because we give training. But you have to speak English and Spanish, because a lot of our customers are tourists. You also have to be on time and wear our uniform: a blue shirt and black pants. We give you the shirt. The salary is 1,500 pesos a week, plus a discount on all our shoes. Can you use a computer? Great, but it isn't necessary. To apply, send your resume by email before Friday, May 9. The next week, we call the best people for an interview. Last year we hired three students, and they loved it!

questions.q: When does the salesperson work?
questions.explain_es: El anuncio busca a alguien for weekends and Wednesday afternoons.

questions.q: Who can apply for this job?
options: Only people with a lot of experience
A person with no experience who speaks two languages
questions.explain_es: No es necesario tener experiencia (you don't have to), pero sí hay que hablar inglés y español.

questions.q: What does the store give the new salesperson?
questions.explain_es: Dice We give you the shirt. Los pantalones negros los tiene que poner la persona.

questions.q: What is NOT necessary for this job?
questions.explain_es: Sobre la computadora dice it isn't necessary. Hablar inglés y llegar a tiempo sí son obligatorios (have to).

questions.q: What happens after Friday, May 9?
options: The store invites some people to an interview.
The store has a big sale.
questions.explain_es: La semana siguiente llaman a las mejores personas para una entrevista. Los tres estudiantes fueron el año pasado.

script.en: Good morning, Ms. Herrera. Please sit down. So, you applied for the receptionist job.
Yes, I saw the ad online last week.
Great. Tell me about your experience.
I worked at a hotel in Cancún for two years. I answered the phone and helped guests with their reservations.
Very good. Can you speak any other languages?
I can speak English and Spanish well. I can speak a little French, but not very well.
The job is full-time, and sometimes you have to work on Saturdays. Is that a problem?
No, that's fine. Do I have to wear a uniform?
No, you don't. You just have to dress formally. The salary is twelve thousand pesos a month.
That sounds good. Thank you for your time.

questions.q: What job is the interview for?
questions.explain_es: El entrevistador dice you applied for the receptionist job.

questions.q: Where did Ms. Herrera work before?
questions.explain_es: Ella dice I worked at a hotel in Cancún for two years.

questions.q: Which language does Ms. Herrera speak badly?
questions.explain_es: Ella dice que habla un poco de francés, but not very well. Inglés y español los habla bien.

questions.q: What does she sometimes have to do in the new job?
questions.explain_es: El entrevistador dice sometimes you have to work on Saturdays.

questions.q: What is true about the uniform?
options: She doesn't have to wear one.
She has to wear it on Saturdays.
questions.explain_es: Cuando ella pregunta por el uniforme, la respuesta es No, you don't: no es necesario, solo vestir formal.

use.q: My sister is ___ engineer.
use.explain_es: Antes de una profesión va a o an. Engineer empieza con sonido de vocal, así que es an engineer.

use.q: She ___ drive, but she can't fix a car.
use.explain_es: Can no cambia con she y el verbo va después sin to: she can drive.

use.q: Paul ___ wear a uniform at work.
use.explain_es: Para obligación con he o she se usa has to + verbo.

use.q: Tomorrow is a holiday, so we ___ go to the office.
use.explain_es: Si es día festivo no es necesario ir: we don't have to. Con we se usa don't, no doesn't.

use.q: I ___ my homework every evening.
use.explain_es: Con homework se usa do: I do my homework.

use.q: My brother is a ___. He fixes cars.
use.explain_es: La persona que arregla coches es el mecánico: mechanic.

use.q: A: Did you ___ the exam? B: Yes! I got a good grade.
use.explain_es: Aprobar un examen es pass. Approve es un falso amigo que significa estar de acuerdo o autorizar.

use.q: Yesterday I ___ stay late to finish the report.
use.explain_es: Yesterday indica pasado. El pasado de have to es had to para todas las personas.

use.q: The meeting starts at ten, so please be ___ time.
use.explain_es: Ser puntual se dice be on time.

use.q: I work twenty hours a week. It's a ___ job.
use.explain_es: Veinte horas a la semana es medio tiempo: a part-time job.

writing.prompt_es: Viste un anuncio de trabajo de medio tiempo en una tienda. Escribe un email corto para solicitar el empleo. Di qué trabajo quieres, tu experiencia, dos cosas que sabes hacer (can) y cuándo puedes trabajar.
writing.prompt_en: You saw an ad for a part-time job in a store. Write a short email to apply for the job. Say which job you want, your experience, two things you can do, and when you can work.
writing.model_answer: Dear Ms. López, I want to apply for the part-time salesperson job. I worked at a clothing store for one year. I can speak English and Spanish, and I can use a computer well. I can work on weekends. Thank you, Ana Ruiz
checklist_es: Un saludo formal (Dear...) y una despedida
El trabajo que quieres con apply for
Tu experiencia (I worked at... o I have experience in...)
Dos habilidades con can
Cuándo puedes trabajar

read_aloud: I applied for a full-time job, and I have an interview on Monday.
Nurses sometimes have to work at night, but teachers don't have to.
questions: What do you do? Do you work or study?
What can you do well? What can't you do?
What do you have to do every day at work or at school?
